 Published Nov. 2, 2026 2:02 a.m. ET share facebook x reddit link Associated Press Phoenix Suns (1-3, 12th in the Western Conference) vs. Golden State Warriors (4-3, ninth in the Western Conference)
 San Francisco; Monday, 10 p.m. EST
 LINE: Warriors -4.5; over/under is 227.5
 BOTTOM LINE: Golden State will look to keep its four-game win streak alive when the Warriors take on Phoenix.
 Golden State finished 37-45 overall and 24-28 in Western Conference play last season. The Warriors averaged 114.6 points per game last season, 17.0 from the free-throw line and 47.1 from deep.
 Phoenix finished 45-37 overall and 10-7 in Pacific Division action during the 2025-26 season. The Suns averaged 24.6 assists per game on 41.0 made field goals last season.
 The teams meet for the second time this season. The Suns won 131-122 in the last matchup on Oct. 25.
 INJURIES: Warriors: Draymond Green: out (rest), Stephen Curry : out (rest), Moses Moody: out (knee), Kristaps Porzingis: out (illness), Jimmy Butler III: out (knee).
 Suns: Mark Williams: out (shoulder).
